headline: Red Sox keep rolling in Chicago with another dominant shutout victory
morning_brew: That is five in a row for the boys in red, and I have officially stopped checking the standings through my fingers like I'm watching a horror movie. Jake Bennett was absolute nails on Wednesday, tossing seven shutout innings and keeping the White Sox hitters guessing all damn night. It is the kind of performance that shifts the entire energy in the clubhouse, especially after the mess we were looking at just a few days ago. He only walked one guy, and those four strikeouts were efficient, letting him dictate the pace of that game from the very first pitch.

The bats finally woke up to back him up, with Tsung-Che Cheng breaking through for a multi-RBI night that we have been waiting to see for what feels like an eternity. The offense is clicking, the pitching is holding, and even the guys coming out of the bullpen in the late innings looked like they actually knew what they were doing for once. It feels like this team is finally finding a rhythm, and when we play with this kind of consistency, the standings start to look a whole lot more respectable than they did last week.

We have a quick turnaround with a day game in Chicago before we head out to New York for a series with the Mets. My neighbor Rick has been pacing his driveway for an hour talking about his newest trade deadline conspiracy theories, but I told him to shut his yap and just enjoy the current streak for a few more hours. For once, things are actually going our way, and I am not gonna be the one to look for a dark cloud while we are riding this kind of momentum.

news_digest.headline: Bennett, Cheng lead the Red Sox past the White Sox, 5-0
news_digest.dans_take: A clean sweep of the stat sheet is a damn good way to spend a Wednesday night.

trend_watch.dans_take: That is how you handle your business on the road, absolute masterclass in command from start to finish.

trend_watch.trend: First multi-RBI performance of the season
trend_watch.dans_take: He finally found his spots and delivered exactly when the team needed a big gap hit.

trend_watch.trend: Two strikeouts in a scoreless inning
trend_watch.dans_take: Coming in and throwing absolute gas with two punchouts is exactly what we need to keep the arson squad at bay.
